Description: Gutkeled nembeli Joachim is the formidable second son of Ban István I. Endowed with predatory political intellect, cold calculation, and boundless ambition, Joachim represents the ascendant baronial oligarchy that redefined Central Europe. His prestigious marriage to Princess Maria Romanovna of Novogrudok connected him directly to the Rurikid dynasty of Galicia, vastly elevating his dynastic standing. While outwardly maintaining faithful service to King Béla IV alongside his father, Joachim quietly constructed a sweeping private network of alliances across Slavonia and Transdanubia. In 1259, observing the escalating royal feud between father and son, Joachim maneuvers with consummate cunning, gathering retainers and biding his time to seize sovereign control over the destiny of the realm. Joachim shuttled between Buda and his southern castles, deploying clan treasuries to cultivate powerful alliances among palace guard officers and regional counts. He quietly maneuvered family partisans into critical fiscal chanceries and toll stations across Transdanubia, guaranteeing that his defensive squares held firm under all tactical conditions. His patient, calculating statecraft steadily built an empire of influence, anticipating the chaotic feudal disputes that would soon shake the monarchy. His keen strategic vision and mastery over aristocratic factions ensured that Clan Gutkeled stood prepared to dominate the high politics of the kingdom.
Motivations: Seize supreme fiscal and military dominance over Hungary, establishing an unassailable oligarchic dynasty.
Exploit royal divisions to extort vital crown domains, revenues, and supreme offices.
Values: Believe immense wealth and unsentimental cunning alone dictate survival, viewing morality as weakness.
Value patient scheming and sudden, devastating action to eliminate political rivals.
Fears: Fears a unified monarchy restoring iron centralized authority and liquidating ambitious oligarchs.
Dreads premature exposure of his conspiracies uniting royalist barons against him.
SpeechStyle: Crowns may glitter, but true power belongs to the gold in our vaults and the swords sworn to my hand! Patience; destiny belongs to the ruthlessly bold! Destiny belongs to the bold; our swords and gold shall rule this realm!
